Take the flexible rod 'C' and bend it manually at the zigzag marks to create a 90-degree angle for the setup.
Mount the assembled brackets to the wall above the window using a power drill and screws. Make sure they are secure.
Snap the curtain tracks into the mounted brackets. Install the two straight inner tracks first, then the bent rod 'C' in front.
Hang your sheer curtains and drapes by hooking the fabric onto the sliders of the inner and middle rods.
